profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Meta | UC Berkeley alum
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with experience building large-scale safety, integrity, and real-time backend
systems at Meta and Albertsons. Specialized in youth safety, regulatory compliance, ML-assisted
risk detection, and high-throughput distributed pipelines supporting millions of users and thousands
of stores.

My technical skills include Java, PHP, Python, JavaScript, SQL, RESTful APIs, and GraphQL
Always open to new amazing opportunities! 
Feel free to reach out to me 

Email: gyeongminlee1@gmail.com
Resume: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1W_tZjVqmkyaAs5UP321tZ-19GaLdnfDa/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=113410215986914781834&rtpof=true&sd=true

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Menlo Park, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Instagram Teen Account Experience Team

▪ Teen Value Project
Led end-to-end backend delivery for Instagram Teen Value project, owning personalization infrastructure, storage architecture, GraphQL APIs, observability, caching, and launch readiness across Product, ML, Infrastructure, Search, Client, and Trust & Safety teams.
Designed foundational User → Project → Chapter → Media storage schema and GraphQL API layer powering media save/remove, project/chapter CRUD, personalized recommendations, pagination, and privacy-safe data ownership.

▪ Threads Teen Account Privacy 
Led end-to-end migration of Threads teen account profile privacy settings to the Settings2 framework, enabling 64M teen user enrollments with accurate age bucketing, regulatory compliance across Instagram & Threads, and enhanced default privacy protections for ~25M early teens 

▪ Youth Regulatory Compliance (Australia SMMA & California SB-976)
Achieved 99.7% notification delivery to 300K+ Australian U16 users via multi-channel campaign 
Enrolled 2.46M California teens (2.10M IG, 355K FB) in SB-976 regulatory experience with ~100% compliance rate; fixed 40+ bugs across Phase 1/2; built monitoring dashboards with DS/DE partners; provided on-site technical support for live UXR with CA teen–guardian pairs.

- Proactive Platform Integrity Team
Meta developer Platform Integrity & Security

Spam & Spoofing Application Submission Detection
• Developers with malicious intent submit the low-quality Meta quest Store apps that are not materially different from the apps that are previously submitted

Meta Quest Store App’s Integrity Risks Reports Noise Filtering & Categorization 
• Improved the review rate of Meta's "Flag This App" reports and saved investigator capacity, thereby identifying the prevalence of integrity issues

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Ecommerce Operation App Team

Capacity Inline change 

•  Spearheaded the development of an inline change for Albertsons' store employee capacity management system, seamlessly integrating it with the UI while managing metadata, utilizing MongoDB to drive efficient data storage and retrieval
•  Implemented a real-time API and Kafka messaging queue, facilitating rapid inline changes and optimizing data management for 2200+ grocery stores nationwide

positions.title: Teaching Assistant CS 198: Algorithm Thinking
positions.description:
Assisted an instructor and 40 students through mini-lectures and Q&A sessions in the Data Structures and algorithm class.

Facilitated three-hour labs twice a week, mentoring students on their assignments and projects.

Conducted daily quizzes and gave individualized feedback to students.

Taught how to implement several algorithms(eg. LinkedList, Dynamic programming, Graph traversal) with Java and Python

company.name: UC Berkeley Electrical Engineering & Computer Sciences (EECS)

positions.title: Teaching Assistant PREP MDS
positions.description:
Lead students to rapidly ideate, design, and prototype innovative engineering systems. 

1st Place Winner and Project Team Leader 

Taught Arduino, sensors, 3D modeling, 3D printing, laser cutters, electronics, data analytics, and visualization.

projects.title: Database Management System Implementation
projects.description:
• Implemented PNLJ, BNLJ, Sort Merge Join, and query optimization using pushdown left deep
plans and dynamic programming for the minimum-cost join based on the query.

• Built lock manager that can handle holding and releasing compatible transactions.

projects.title: BYOW (Java)
projects.description:
• Designed and implemented a 2D tile-based world exploration engine
• Finds the shortest route between two locations and includes an auto complete search feature.
• Implemented function to save, load, replay game for several users can play the game.
